items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Pappoos. His father helped me a lot when I was a kid.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Pappoos. His father helped me a lot when I was a kid. So I grabbed him and started training him. Once they could play an instrument, as much as I knew about music and the way I felt about it, I felt like I could help them. Uh huh. Not around reading. Yeah. I mean by air. Yeah. He was really a great little guitar player. You had to go and find him. Wherever you go, reason or what's not. They had to be real good at talking. Because his daddy was tremendous. Yeah. He helped me along with it. And then we…

I used to see you play when I was a kid. Yeah. When I was really young. Yeah. I can remember that group. Yeah. And myself. Yeah. You played fine piano I think. Yeah. I mean I just, I like to dream you know. Yeah. Yeah.
